errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are present for every single year from 2007 to 2027, not for every two years.
The labels on the y-axis are spaced every 2 percentage points (5,0%, 7,0%, 9,0%, etc.), not every 1%.
The marker for the orange line, corresponding to 'УниКредит Булбанк', is a square, not a dot ('точка').
For the first (orange) line, the value in 2012 is at its peak, approximately 17%, not 14%.
The second (dark green) line starts at approximately 12.5% in 2007, not 10%.
The second (dark green) line reaches its maximum of approximately 18% in the year 2010, not 17.5% in 2011.

errors.evidence: The dark blue line, corresponding to 'Пощенска банка', has triangle markers, not square markers.

The description does not identify which line corresponds to which bank from the legend (e.g., 'УниКредит Булбанк', 'Банка ДСК'). It only refers to them as 'First line', 'Second line', etc., which makes the description ambiguous and difficult to connect to the source data.
